WGI RELIABILITY FINDING 2026-08-03 (observed while running the task-012_5 prerequisite sequence — directly relevant to this task's premise of unattended automated ingestion). The World Bank API was degraded for at least 75 minutes and bronze_WGI could NOT complete: (a) 14:08 pipeline run — failed twice on GOV_WGI_GE.EST pages 3 then 4 (16m47s, 3m54s), succeeded only on the 3rd pipeline-level attempt (4m7s); (b) 15:24 standalone notebook probe — ran 11m35s then RuntimeError on GOV_WGI_RL.EST page 3. Partial progress in (b): CC.EST 5158 records, GE.EST 5127, PV.EST 5214, RL.EST failed. DIAGNOSIS: random per-request read timeouts (timeout=60), NOT indicator- or page-specific — GE.EST failed in (a) and succeeded in (b). ~5150 records/indicator at per_page=1000 => ~6 pages x 6 indicators = ~36 requests per run; at the observed ~50% timeout rate with max_retries=3 and a 2*attempt backoff (2s, 4s), a clean run is effectively impossible. The backoff is the weak point: retrying 2 seconds after a 60-second timeout retries into the same congestion. IMPLICATION FOR THIS TASK: AC1 ('a full pipeline run completes with zero manual file uploads') is not currently satisfiable on a bad API day. Whether that counts as a task failure or as the real-world finding the task exists to surface is Erik's call — but a scheduled pipeline (task-010) would inherit this fragility. EPI is unaffected: bronze_EPI succeeded in 75s in the same run.
